title: Book Three · Chapter 148: The Second Two Yuan
story:
On the last Saturday before the winter holiday, Ronan starts his second work morning.

A man comes early to collect two small shelves. Ronan finds the name and the drawing before he touches the finished pieces.

There are three similar shelves on the top level. Two belong to this man. The third has another name.

Ronan puts the man's paper beside the right pair and calls Mr Sun.

The man points toward the third shelf.

“That one has a higher edge.”

“It is for another order,” Ronan says.

“Could mine have that?”

Ronan looks at the drawing. The man originally wanted the shelves below a low window.

The man brings his hand down beside the higher edge.

“I like the look of it.”

Ronan puts the drawing flat where they can both see it. The window is above the long shelf line.

“Is this still the right place?”

“Yes.”

The customer looks at the empty space between the two lines. He puts his hand above his own shelves, then lifts it nearer the height of the other one.

Ronan does not move the third shelf from its place. Its label has another customer's name.

The man lowers his hand again.

“I was looking at the wood.”

He smiles a little. Ronan turns the paper so the window is the right way up for him.

“I forgot the glass.”

Mr Sun is coming toward the front now. Ronan keeps the two orders apart and leaves the drawing beside the finished pair.

The customer looks at both again. Then he brings the drawing nearer and studies the low window on the page.

“Will it still fit there?”

The man puts his hand above the wood and thinks.

“Perhaps not.”

Mr Sun joins them. He checks the drawing with the customer and explains the clear space at the window.

The man tries the edge with his own hand. Then he nods toward his pair.

“Keep these.”

While Mr Sun checks the payment, Ronan brings paper for the shelves. He puts the two labels face up on top so they stay clear.

The customer leaves with the finished pair. The third shelf stays in its place.

Later, a woman brings a chair drawing. Ronan asks where it will stand, then writes the answer below her name.

She looks at his questions.

“You want to know my whole room.”

“Only the part near the chair.”

She laughs and adds the table to her picture.

At the short break, Dad comes to the front with water. Ronan tells him about the higher edge.

Dad looks at the window drawing.

“The room is part of the job.”

“Quite a large part.”

Dad smiles and puts the water beside him. He goes back to the measuring table while Ronan drinks.

At twelve, Mr Sun pays the second two yuan. Ronan has earned four from the new agreement. One morning remains.

At home, the work envelope now holds twenty-five yuan. He writes the new amount below the previous one.

Kai comes to the door after lunch with his own football. Ronan leaves the envelope at home and brings his water.

“No paper?” Kai asks.

“The field has no customer names.”

“It knows your long passes.”

Ronan laughs and shuts the green door behind them. At the park, Kai sends him a short pass first, and Ronan stops it before they choose their sides.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

similar＝相似的；originally＝最初；higher＝更高的；previous＝前一次的。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么那位顾客不能直接拿走第三个架子？他最后取走哪一对？
2. 新约定已实做几次、收入多少？工资信封现在是多少？

## 读句子

**One morning remains.**

拆开看：One morning / remains.

一个工作日上午／还没完成。
